findings.text: blocking: the two holds added here and at pipeline.py:1987 are never cleared. clear_holds_not_raised is the only writer of status='cleared' (holds.py:118) and its sole caller passes checked_hold_kinds = {registry_conformance, banned_prose, documentation_contradiction} at workers.py:11284, so docs_lint_error and cascade_contradiction are absent from every re-check and stay open for the life of the name. A document whose contradiction veto or lint error is later resolved is then re-claimed by the refine predicate at graph_ops.py:25697 ('score < $min_score OR open docs hold'), is held again by the stale row on its next pass, and walks docs_chain_length to rotation_cap, ending 'exhausted'. The clamp this replaces recomputed on every pass and did not stick, so the change converts a per-pass refusal into a permanent one; either the two kinds belong in the checked set wherever those checks run, or a route's kind should be cleared when route.holds comes back empty.

non-blocking: manifest.md:101-102 records test_consumer_predicates_agree_with_rubric_route as 'passed at base and at head', while gate-base.log and gate-head.log each end '9 failed' with that test's nine [*-docs] parameters listed as FAILED; the record's own after_suite and follow_ons say the nine still fail, so the tests[] entry overstates what the gate shows a reader.

non-blocking: the quarantined-row test does not isolate the quarantine exclusion it names. Its planted row carries no HAS_REVIEW edge, so PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE refuses it on docs_review_eligibility_where() alone; the quarantine clause can be deleted and this test still passes, so a regression that drops only the quarantine exclusion is not caught by any test in this change, so the exclusion this test names is taken on the owner's word (graph_ops.py:12558) rather than measured here.

non-blocking: the graph parameter added to _cap_docs_scores_for_lint_errors is never supplied by any caller (the only call site at pipeline.py:2185 omits it), and the call it guards is the one graph write in this change left outside try/except, unlike the cascade site's hold raise wrapped at cascade.py:762, so a transient graph fault aborts a whole docs review batch where the quarantined route only logs and continues.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified 4 production call sites: workers.py:11222 (docs review batch, which calls adjudicate_review and persist_reviewed_docs), pipeline.py:2185 (the lint-cap call site inside _review_single_batch), graph_ops.py:17931 (persist_reviewed_docs calls clear_holds_not_raised, which reaches _promote_if_eligible) and promote.py:775.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 0ef17240c; the single commit d93b086a1 changes eight files, being three runtime modules (pipeline.py, cascade.py, holds.py), the promotion row in standard_names/AGENTS.md, three test modules and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when is no added failures, each site recorded before and after, and the negative-control log kept; gate-head.log ends '9 failed, 93 passed' against gate-base.log's '9 failed, 79 passed' with the same nine pre-existing test_consumer_predicates_agree_with_rubric_route[*-docs] ids, negative-control.log shows the three red lint-cap tests, and the fragment records each site before and after.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to route the documentation lint cap and the Jev contradiction veto through review holds and to release a document by dismissal only through the canonical gate; pipeline.py:1987 raises docs_lint_error in place of the score clamp, cascade.py:225-236 attaches a cascade_contradiction hold while keeping decision_score at its mapped value, and holds.py:155 applies PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE, so all three landed.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reports the holds.py delegation, the two hold kinds and the self-declared widening with readable baseline_suite and after_suite receipts, but its tests[] entry at manifest.md:101-102 claims a pass for test_consumer_predicates_agree_with_rubric_route that both gate arms contradict.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The brief grants pipeline.py, cascade.py, holds.py, standard_names/AGENTS.md, test_review_holds.py and the evidence fragment; the d93b086a1 diff also writes tests/standard_names/test_review_cascade.py and tests/standard_names/test_review_findings_cap.py, which the brief requires to be updated but the declared write paths omit.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows test_lint_error_raises_a_hold_and_keeps_the_judged_score reddening when the clamp is restored, and the dismissal test at test_review_holds.py:447 would redden under the predicate it replaced, but the quarantined row at test_review_holds.py:456 also lacks a winning review, so that test cannot isolate the quarantine exclusion it names.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log's summary '9 failed, 93 passed' against gate-base.log's '9 failed, 79 passed' is recorded on disk and supports the zero-delta claim, but the base four-file arm's 10 test_review_holds.py error records appear in neither baseline_suite nor the manifest analysis, and manifest.md:101-102 claims a pass the log contradicts.
justifications.fit: raise_route_holds at cascade.py:346 and the CascadeRoute.holds field at cascade.py:44 follow the surrounding style, the module docstring at cascade.py:6-8 carries the change, and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in any added name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: pipeline.py:1976-1997 raises docs_lint_error and no longer writes entry['reviewer_score'], and cascade.py:225-236 keeps mapped/decision_score at the judged value while attaching the added CascadeRoute.holds field, which is exactly the goal.
justifications.reuse: holds.py:156-160 imports PROMOTE_STRANDED_DOCS_WHERE and docs_review_eligibility_params from their owner at graph_ops.py:12558 and graph_ops.py:6670 rather than restating the predicate, and every hold is raised through the holds.py:51 owner, so the release path extends the owner rather than forking it.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/standard_names/test_review_cascade.py and tests/standard_names/test_review_findings_cap.py were written outside the write paths declared at manifest.md:15-21, and pipeline.py:1968 adds a graph parameter no caller supplies.
